about: Fog lights (beenster 17 Nov): a pair clamped to the fork's upper tubes, outside each leg; foundry/foglamps3d.py. Lit on the game's light toggle (off, dipped, high, high + fog) as the fog_lights slot.

fogs.name: Chrome spot lamps
fogs.note: Deep chrome bowls with a rolled rim, a silvered reflector and a bulb behind clear domed glass, on chrome arms.

fogs.name: Amber fog lamps
fogs.note: Black bowls with a chrome rim and a yellow-amber glass: the old-school fog lamp.

fogs.name: Rally lamps
fogs.note: Bigger black round lamps with a satin rim, a reflector and a projector: for the long dark lanes.

fogs.name: LED cube pods
fogs.note: Small square black pods with cooling fins at the back and four LEDs behind a clear face.

fogs.name: Slim LED bars
fogs.note: A short slim LED bar each side, black with a light strip across a clear face.
